ACHR.name: Actor
ACHR.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/ACHR. An ACHR is an actor placed in the world. [measured: 5,639 XLCN and 2,701 XLRT fields in Skyrim.esm]

DATA.name: Locational Data
DATA.note: The actor's x, y and z position and rotation, in radians.

NAME.name: Base Object
NAME.note: The formid of the actor this places.

XLCN.name: Location
XLCN.note: The LCTN record the actor is in.

XLKR.name: Linked Reference
XLKR.note: The keyword and the REFR the reference is linked to, usually a STAT. [measured: 12,778 of the 12,782 XLKR fields in Skyrim.esm are 8 bytes]

LVLI.name: Leveled Item
LVLI.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/LVLI. A leveled item is a list of entries, each with a level, an item and a count. [measured: 3,075 LVLD and LVLF fields and 3,056 LLCT fields in Skyrim.esm; the three are single bytes, not the dwords the names might suggest]

LLCT.name: Entry Count
LLCT.note: How many entries the list has, which is the number of LVLO records.

LVLD.name: Chance For No Spawn
LVLD.note: The chance that an item on this list is not spawned at all. For example, 75 means there is a 25% chance to spawn an item.

LVLF.name: Flags
LVLF.note: 0x01 = All Levels, which sets it to calculate for every entry below the player level and choose randomly among them. 0x02 = Each, which repeats the check every time the list is called rather than reusing the result. 0x04 = Use All, which uses every entry when the list is called. 0x08 = Special Loot.

WEAP.name: Weapon
WEAP.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/WEAP. [measured: 2,484 WEAP records in Skyrim.esm; DATA is 10 bytes, CRDT is 24 and DNAM is 100]

CNAM.name: Template
CNAM.note: The WEAP record to use as a template.

CRDT.name: Critical Damage
CRDT.note: UESP, Skyrim Mod:Mod File Format/WEAP. The Special Edition's CRDT is 24 bytes; the base's is Fallout's 16-byte form. [measured: 24 bytes in every CRDT field in Skyrim.esm]

DATA.name: Data
DATA.note: The weapon's value, weight and base damage.

DESC.name: Description
DESC.note: The description shown in the game.

DNAM.name: Weapon Data
DNAM.note: The weapon's animation type, speed, reach, flags, ranges, rumble, skill and stagger.

ETYP.name: Equip Type
ETYP.note: The EQUP record giving the slot the weapon is used in, typically BothHands or EitherHand.

FULL.name: Full Name
FULL.note: The name shown in the game.

INAM.name: Swing Impact Data Set
INAM.note: The normal weapon swing's impact data set (IPDS).

KWDA.name: Keyword
KWDA.note: The keywords. There is one per KSIZ, and KSIZ is a sibling subrecord rather than a count in the data, so the count comes from it.

MODS.name: Alternate Textures
MODS.note: Used when overriding a nif's textures with texture sets.

NAM7.name: Attack Loop Sound
NAM7.note: An SNDR record. Not found in the original files.

SNAM.name: Attack Sound
SNAM.note: The attack sound (trap fire), an SNDR record.

VNAM.name: Sound Detection Level
VNAM.note: How much sound using the weapon makes. It seems to be used when working out whether a nearby NPC notices the actor using it: 0 = Loud, 1 = Normal, 2 = Silent, 3 = Very Loud.

WNAM.name: First Person Model Object
WNAM.note: The STAT record for the first person model. It affects the inventory item's display.
